question: Does stating in the revision prompt that owned and assumed ingredients the revised dish still uses stay in the ingredient list stop answers that drop staples without a reason (served as failed: unexplained_change)?
trigger: Phone end-to-end check: 두부부침 with only 두부 owned failed twice with unexplained_change; the model kept only 두부 in the list and dropped the assumed staples (식용유 without a reason).
inputs: the 36 frozen synthetic cases (cases.json, fixtures.json) plus the demo case tofu-pan with ['두부'] against the served recipe file (artifacts, untracked)

variants.keep: the same text with one added sentence in rule 2: keep every owned or assumed source ingredient the revised recipe still uses in the ingredient list, with its source amount; only omitted or replaced ingredients leave the list

model: google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite, temperature 0, one run per variant, served Reviser path (prescreen, check, main-ingredient rule)
metrics: served status per case (revised/refused/failed) and failure code
cases expected revise that are served revised
wrong recipes served for expect=refuse cases
assumed rows dropped from the revised list
analysis: per-case paired table old vs keep; counts; no pass/fail thresholds; the decision is a judgement written after the numbers
